responsibility: Defines the `rustc_typeck` crate’s top-level type-checking pipeline and shared entry points. It wires submodule query providers together, orchestrates the major crate-wide phases—collection, outlives/variance testing hooks, impl WF checking, coherence, WF checking, item/body type checking, unused-item lints, and entry-function validation—and exposes helper conversions from HIR types and traits into internal type/predicate forms.
